cards.ex: My sister and I don't always see eye to eye, especially when it comes to politics.
cards.exUz: Singlim bilan men har doim bir fikrda bo'lmaymiz, ayniqsa siyosat haqida gap ketganda.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrlarga ega bo'lish, kelishmovchilik bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: He's a real chip off the old block; he loves fixing cars just like his dad.
cards.exUz: U otasining haqiqiy nusxasi; u otasi kabi mashinalarni tuzatishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onasiga o'xshagan bola, xarakteri yoki qobiliyatlari bilan.

cards.ex: After years of feuding, the two families decided to bury the hatchet.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillik adovatdan so'ng, ikki oila sulh tuzishga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Janjallashishni to'xtatish va kelishib olish, dushmanlikni unutish.

cards.ex: Those two have been thick as thieves since they met in college.
cards.exUz: Ular kollejda tanishganidan beri juda yaqin do'stlar.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin do'stlar, sirni saqlaydigan, doimo birga bo'ladigan.

cards.ex: I hold my grandparents dear because they've always been there for me.
cards.exUz: Men buvim va bobomni juda qadrlayman, chunki ular har doim yonimda bo'lishgan.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir juda qadrlash, hurmat qilish va yaxshi ko'rish.

cards.ex: They got on like a house on fire from the moment they met at the party.
cards.exUz: Ular partiyada uchrashgan zahoti tezda do'stlashib qolishdi.
cards.term: get on like a house on fire
cards.uzDef: Tezda do'stlashib qolish, bir-biriga juda mos kelish.

cards.ex: It's no surprise they became friends; birds of a feather flock together, after all.
cards.exUz: Ularning do'st bo'lgani ajablanarli emas; axir, tur doshidan.
cards.term: birds of a feather flock together
cards.uzDef: O'xshash odamlar birga bo'lishadi, bir xil qiziqishlarga ega.

cards.ex: We used to be close, but we drifted apart after high school.
cards.exUz: Ilgari biz yaqin edik, lekin o'rta maktabdan keyin uzoqlashdik.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan do'stlik yoki munosabatlarning zaiflashishi.

cards.ex: If you need someone to lend an ear, I'm here for you.
cards.exUz: Agar sizga tinglaydigan odam kerak bo'lsa, men siz uchun shu yerdaman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan tinglash, g'amxo'rlik bilan eshitish.

cards.ex: She decided to cut ties with her toxic friends.
cards.exUz: U o'zining zaharli do'stlari bilan aloqani uzishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan munosabatlarni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: Even when things got tough, my friends stood by me, and I'll always appreciate that.
cards.exUz: Ishlar qiyinlashganda ham, do'stlarim meni qo'llab-quvvatlashdi va men bundan doim minnatdorman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir qiyin vaziyatda ham doimiy ravishda qo'llab-quvvatlash, yordam berish.

cards.ex: I didn't like him at first, but he's really grown on me lately.
cards.exUz: Dastlab u menga yoqmadi, lekin oxirgi paytlarda u menga juda yoqib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Dastlab yoqmagan narsa asta-sekin yoqa boshlashi, ko'nikish.

cards.ex: She's always helping others; she has a heart of gold.
cards.exUz: U doimo boshqalarga yordam beradi; uning oltin yuragi bor.
cards.uzDef: Juda mehribon, saxiy va yaxshi inson ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: I've always looked up to my older brother; he's a real inspiration.
cards.exUz: Men har doim akamni hurmat qilaman; u haqiqiy ilhom manbai.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yuqori baholash, ularning xatti-harakatlaridan namuna olish.

cards.ex: She always sees the best in people, even when they don't deserve it.
cards.exUz: U har doim odamlarda yaxshi narsalarni ko'radi, hatto ular bunga loyiq bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning xususiyatlarida faqat ijobiy tomonlarni ko'rishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's a real people person; everyone loves being around him.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy odamjon; hamma uning atrofida bo'lishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar bilan oson til topisha oladigan, muloqot qilishni yaxshi ko'radigan inson.

cards.ex: It's important that we're on the same page about how to raise our children.
cards.exUz: Bolalarimizni qanday tarbiyalash haqida bir xil fikrda bo'lishimiz muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish, kelishib olish.

cards.ex: They've hit a rough patch in their marriage, but they're trying to work it out.
cards.exUz: Ularning nikohida qiyin davr, lekin ular uni hal qilishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarda yoki hayotda qiyin davrni boshdan kechirish.

cards.ex: I knew from the moment we met that she was a kindred spirit.
cards.exUz: Biz uchrashganimizdayoq, u mening qadrdon ruhim ekanligini bildim.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash fikrlar va qadriyatlarga ega bo'lgan inson.

cards.ex: True friends always have each other's backs, no matter what.
cards.exUz: Haqiqiy do'stlar doimo bir-birini himoya qiladilar, nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar.
cards.uzDef: Bir-birini qo'llab-quvvatlash, himoya qilish, yordam berish.

cards.ex: I try to be there for my friends whenever they need me.
cards.exUz: Do'stlarimga yordam kerak bo'lganda, men ularning yonida bo'lishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga yordam kerak bo'lganda yonida bo'lish, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: We cherish our relationship and always make time for each other.
cards.exUz: Biz munosabatlarimizni qadrlaymiz va doimo bir-birimizga vaqt ajratamiz.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni juda qadrlash, ularni saqlashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He always speaks his mind, even if it's not what people want to hear.
cards.exUz: U doimo o'z fikrini aytadi, hatto odamlar buni eshitishni xohlamasa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini ochiq va to'g'ri aytish, hech narsadan qo'rqmasdan.

cards.ex: They have a strong bond that nothing can break.
cards.exUz: Ularning o'rtasida hech narsa buza olmaydigan kuchli bog'liqlik bor.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar o'rtasida kuchli aloqa yoki munosabat bo'lishi.

cards.ex: His granddaughter is the apple of his eye.
cards.exUz: Uning nabirasi uning ko'z qorachig'i.
cards.uzDef: Juda seviladigan va qadrlanadigan inson.

cards.ex: He started to distance himself from his old friends after he got married.
cards.exUz: Uylangandan keyin u eski do'stlaridan o'zini uzoq tuta boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir yoki nimadandir o'zini uzoqroq tutish, aloqani kamaytirish.

cards.ex: I'm on the outs with my sister right now after our argument.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin hozir singlim bilan kelishmovchilikdaman.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir bilan munosabatlar yomonlashgan, kelishmovchilik bor.

cards.ex: They decided to bury the past and start fresh.
cards.exUz: Ular o'tmishni unutish va yangi hayot boshlashga qaror qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi xafagarchiliklarni unutish va yangi munosabatlar o'rnatish.

cards.ex: She really takes after her mother in both looks and personality.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishi va xarakteri bilan onasiga juda o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xulq-atvori yoki tashqi ko'rinishi bilan kimdirga o'xshash.

cards.ex: They may argue, but blood runs deeper than any disagreement.
cards.exUz: Ular bahslashishi mumkin, lekin qon har qanday kelishmovchilikdan chuqurroq.
cards.uzDef: Oila munosabatlari boshqa munosabatlardan ustunroq ekanligini bildiradi.
